regulations.name: Apex.Payroll
regulations.description: Apex Digital Solutions LLC — Level 2 regulation extending US.Payroll with company-specific benefits: §132(f) commuter transit benefit (WT 1250 pre-tax up to the monthly limit, WT 5520 post-tax excess) and WFH equipment stipend (WT 1260). No modification of the base US.Payroll regulation required.

cases.name: Apex.Benefits
cases.description: Apex Digital Solutions LLC company-specific employee benefits. Extends US.Payroll without modifying base regulation.

fields.name: Apex.TransitBenefitMonthly
fields.description: Monthly commuter transit salary-reduction election. IRC §132(f): excluded from FIT and FICA up to the monthly limit (FederalTaxParameters.TransitMonthlyLimit, $340 for 2026); the excess is taxable and withheld after tax. Converted to the pay period as monthly × 12 / periods per year. WT 1250 = excluded part (pre-tax), WT 5520 = excess (post-tax).

fields.name: Apex.WFHStipend
fields.description: Taxable WFH equipment stipend per pay period. Fully taxable — increases gross (WT 1260 adds to GrossWages collector). No federal or state exclusion applies unless covered by an accountable plan (IRC §62(a)(2)(A)) — which this flat stipend is not.

wageTypes.name: Apex.PreTransitBenefit
wageTypes.description: Pre-tax commuter transit benefit. IRC §132(f): excluded from FIT and FICA up to the monthly limit (FederalTaxParameters.TransitMonthlyLimit). Monthly election capped at the limit and converted to the pay period. Fills the WT 1250 extensibility slot read by USComputeFitTaxable / USComputeFicaTaxable. Returns a negative value. State conformity is not modeled by US.Payroll (CA does not conform).

wageTypes.name: Apex.WFHStipend
wageTypes.description: Taxable WFH equipment stipend. Added to gross pay — increases all taxable wage bases (FIT, FICA, SIT, FUTA). Reads Apex.WFHStipend case field. Returns positive value contributing to GrossWages collector.

wageTypes.name: Apex.TransitExcessPostTax
wageTypes.description: Part of the monthly transit election above the IRC §132(f) monthly limit. Taxable, withheld after tax and converted to the pay period. Numbered below NetPay (WT 6500) so the deduction is included in net pay. Returns a negative value.
